name: @nonsuch/component-library
description: A Vue 3 component library built on Quasar with opinionated defaults and custom components.

scripts.build: vite build && rm -f tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

size-limit.name: full library (gzip) — a SOFT ceiling. 27 kB as of 2026-09-12. NsImageUpload was 1,298 B on first commit and 530 B MORE after two review passes — a disable prop routed through useNsDisabled, two dev warnings (a malformed accept rule; a label slot whose words leave the accessible name), a live region that re-announces repeats, and a drag-flicker guard. That is the price of review, and it is worth paying: every one of those closed a silent failure a reviewer measured. Tightening the warning text saved 0 B at gzip. Epic componentLibrary-lrw has ~6 left; the dev warnings are now ~3.3 kB of this and only dual conditional exports reclaims them — see the conditional-exports bead. RE-SET rather than drift
single component: NsBrandLogo (must not pull more than NsImage, which is 1.38 kB)
app shell (heaviest import; contains NsInput and NsNavSidebar. Includes the en-CA locale object — a ONE-TIME 440 B for the first useNsLocale() consumer in this chunk, ~0 for the next)
manifest subpath (build tooling; must never pull runtime code)

styles (gzip) — ALSO A SOFT CEILING, 7 kB as of 2026-09-12 (NsImageUpload +363 B; the next two components would have tripped 6.75). Before that, raised to 6.75 kB on 2026-09-10. The type ramp put it at 6.25; NsFormSection and NsFormFooter added ~110 B between them and took it 15 B over, which is the shape of the rest of epic componentLibrary-lrw: roughly 50-60 B of scoped CSS per component, with ~10 to build. 6.75 covers those with room, and a single component adding more than ~300 B still trips it. THE FAILURE THIS EXISTS TO CATCH IS ALSO THE FAILURE MODE OF READING IT: the JS entry passed while this one was 15 B over, and a report that grepped only the first entry called the whole gate green. Read every row and the exit code, never a head -n
